name: lean-agent-tools
description: Adds hooks, the brain MCP server, scripted gates and test tools to the lean-agent skills. Install it alongside the lean-agent plugin.

serve_mode.title: Brain page
serve_mode.description: When the brain page server runs: always (from login, after brain serve --install always), session (started with a session, stops 30 minutes after the last one), or manual (brain serve)

worktree_roots.title: Worktree folders
worktree_roots.description: Comma-separated folders the brain page searches for git worktrees, besides the repositories brain already knows
